method: Independent source/spec review. Scores are 0=missing/contradictory, 1=partial, 2=clear. Evidence level is distinct from a score; no source assertion is treated as runtime proof.

blocker_violations.requirement: Invents product claims or fake data as fact.
blocker_violations.evidence: scenario-1/lib/main.dart:64-65 presents an unprovided privacy/data-minimization promise ("نطلب فقط ما تحتاجه") as product fact rather than a marked placeholder.

main.dart:27 and 154-160 select Cairo and 1.6 body line height; pubspec.yaml:17-22 registers bundled font.
main.dart:52-66 is otherwise finance-specific, but :64-65 states an unprovided privacy/data-minimization promise as fact instead of a marked placeholder.
main.dart:163-175 has one filled primary action per step.
main.dart:163-167 sets the primary control to 52 logical pixels; Material text controls supply their platform minimums.

main.dart:94 uses SafeArea and the original test exercises 1.5x/360x640, but independent reproduction at 320x568 and 2x puts every primary action off-screen (bottoms 912/976/927 vs 568) and reports a 368px RenderFlex overflow on step 1.
main.dart uses plain Material surfaces and an icon circle, without gradients/glass/cards.
main.dart:113-116 isolates the progress fraction as LTR.

lines 30-61 group content in native Sections, no custom cards.
lines 32-47 disable child toggles, but turning the parent off destructively clears each stored category choice rather than preserving preferences through a temporary pause.
Native Toggle labels/states plus master accessibility hint at lines 32-35; failure UI is textual.
No custom glass/card content exists.
lines 54-75 visibly retry failures, but .task(id: settings) cancellation plus the saving guard can drop a rapid latest edit while a prior save is in flight.
Material 3 components/theme APIs are intended, but CheckoutAddressScreen.kt:24 imports nonexistent lowercase androidx.compose.material3.dropdownMenuItem, preventing compilation.
dp, phone/IME keyboard behavior and Material controls are present (lines 37, 138-141, 174-191), but no Compose autofill API is implemented and build cannot be verified.
Persistent labels and field-specific supporting errors are implemented at lines 100-107 and 130-163; Continue stays enabled except while submitting.

Country comes from a caller catalog and phone/postal attempt ContentOrLtr, but unconditional postal presence validation (lines 195-199) cannot accommodate locales/countries where it is optional, and no locale formatting is implemented.
safeDrawingPadding, imePadding and vertical scrolling at lines 80-87.
Submitting and Failure states are designed at lines 54-58 and 165-190, but the failure live-region call is source-invalid: liveRegion is a semantics property, not Modifier.liveRegion(...).
The CTA validates rather than being disabled for invalid fields; disabled only during labeled saving.
Native Material controls help, but the intended live region at lines 165-171 is invalid Compose API and the file cannot compile.
response.md:5-7 inventories prior 40/44/46 heights, 14/full/6 radii and 17 padding; fixture diff corroborates it.
theme.ts:3-5 creates semantic geometry tokens, but there is no reusable component variant abstraction.
Screens share one named minimum-height token, not named button sizes/variants.
Screen route/analytics calls remain intact; npm test independently verifies only the Node action contract, not native widget feedback.

The focused screen changes preserve brand/content/identifiers, but theme.radius.control was changed from existing 8 to 12 (fixtures/scenario-5/src/theme.ts vs output), an unrelated visual-token change without evidence it was defective.
Four focused source changes normalize the three existing screens rather than rewriting them.
npm test independently passed for two Node action tests, and response.md accurately reports missing configuration; no lint, typecheck, native build, or widget test was run.
OperationsDashboard.kt:74-91 retains KPIs, alert, chart and timeline in a compact scroll layout.
KPI grid uses plain columns; the only Card is the decision-requiring alert (lines 103-110).

RTL and isolated mixed content are present, but spec.md:41 selects old-to-new operational direction from right to left while chart x at OperationsDashboard.kt:146/153 increases physically left-to-right.

The code attempts ContentOrLtr at lines 120 and 132, but textDirection is not a Text parameter (it belongs in TextStyle), so this source does not compile; bidi isolation also is not locale-aware number/date/unit formatting.
TrendChart contentDescription at line 139 and text status labels avoid color-only status.
lines 67-71 and 113-127 use a 360dp one-column breakpoint plus constrained width; spec documents 320dp/large text.
